data.one_liner: Generate text avatars based on user initials and custom specifications.
data.what_it_does: Generates colorful text avatars from user names or initials. Supports customizable shapes like rectangle or circular, font sizes, colors, and letter counts.
use_when: You need to display user avatars based on initials when an image is unavailable.
You want quick, customizable text-based avatars with predefined or custom colors.
avoid_when: You need to load, crop, or cache actual image files for avatars.
strengths: Easy to use with minimal required parameters.
Supports customizable shapes, text colors, font weights, and background colors.
weaknesses: Limited to text-based avatars from initials.
Not many advanced features beyond basic styling options.
